claims.head: Something has to give
claims.body: The Red Wings are one of the league’s best for the power play, but the Senators are one of the best at the penalty kill. Our lean: the Red Wings’ power play wins out. Power plays usually beat kills in these spots.

DET.head: Close, but the Senators have the slight edge
DET.body: Ottawa has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, but they are on the second night of a back-to-back, and Detroit has home-ice advantage. The Red Wings can tip it if their power play gets going.

OTT.head: Leaning the Senators’ way

story.head: Raymond’s favorite opponent
